0022600171.text: The LA Clippers, 1-5 and 13th in the West, host the 3-2 Toronto Raptors, who sit 5th in the East, in the Clippers' seventh game of the season. LA has lost five straight and is 3 games back in the Pacific, while Toronto has won three of its last five. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), and Derrick Jones Jr. (knee) is day-to-day with a game-time decision. Toronto is missing Jakob Poeltl (shoulder, inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
